description: This PHP class 'RequestPasswordController' handles request password operations within the OrangeHRM system. It manages generating CSRF tokens for password reset requests, setting templates and components based on email configuration, and ensuring security measures are in place for password recovery procedures.

classes.name: RequestPasswordController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling password reset requests, rendering appropriate views based on email configuration, and managing CSRF tokens.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailService, creating one if it does not exist.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component and template before rendering, setting CSRF tokens and warning components based on email configuration.
